result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names. Renaming `buildAndDeployment` no longer breaks the export. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests, and I didn't try a renamed-aspect run.

The change is in `DataExporter.java`, in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/`. The zip block used to read the five scope files by hard-coded names, so a renamed aspect made the read throw and skipped the rest of the block. It now builds the five names with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName` for the main, test, generated, build-and-deploy and other aspects. That is the same call that writes the loose `.txt` files, so the names always match.

With the default configuration the entries are unchanged: `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_test.txt`, `aspect_generated.txt`, `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`, `aspect_other.txt`, in that order. With the rename, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written again when `git-history.txt` exists.

I left `LandscapeAnalyzer.java:283` alone. It also hard-codes `"aspect_build_and_deployment.txt"` and would have the same problem with a renamed aspect. It's outside this export, so I didn't change it.
